prompt: I started renaming an issue, added a comment to explain why, and my unsaved title edit was replaced by the old title.

truth.summary: IssueTitleEditor's componentDidUpdate resets the draft whenever the issue prop's reference changes. Posting a comment invalidates the Issue tag, RTK Query refetches it with a new updatedAt, and the new object wipes the draft.

referenceAnswer.cause: componentDidUpdate resets draft whenever the issue object reference changes; the refetch after posting a comment delivers a new object with the same title.

decoyAnswers.cause: The page remounts IssueTitleEditor after a comment.

genieEvidence.notes: react_inspect_component shows the class state { isEditing: true, draft: <original title> } after the refetch. react_render_causes (appOnly:false, view:full) shows the class rendering for prop 'issue' (exact) and then for 'this.state.draft' in the next commit, whose classUpdates entry is a setState with fields ['draft'] recorded inside IssueTitleEditor's componentDidUpdate (phase lifecycle, evidence exact) with the caller's file and line. The typed edit before it is a setState from the input event (inferred).
